faq.name: faq
faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Questions about AI Kitchen Design
faq.description: What to know before creating your first kitchen concept.

items.title: What kind of photo should I upload?
items.description: Use a clear, well-lit photo that shows as much of the kitchen as possible. Avoid collages, heavy filters and large obstructions.

items.title: Can I keep parts of my current kitchen?
items.description: Yes. You can preserve existing furniture and use the area controls to direct specific changes.

items.title: Do I need to configure every area?
items.description: No. Areas and materials are optional. Unspecified areas can be coordinated by AI with the selected style.

items.title: Can I change a generated design?
items.description: Yes. Open a result, describe the change you want, and save the new image alongside your other results.

items.title: Are the designs construction plans?
items.description: The images are visual concepts. Confirm dimensions, building requirements, materials and installation details with qualified professionals before construction.

items.title: Where are my generated images stored?
items.description: Generated results are associated with your signed-in account so you can access them from the kitchen designer.
